quality_check.description: A 9:16 object sheet shows a warm-brown and worn-brass compact spyglass in one near-side view and one three-quarter view on a neutral textured background, with a narrow rear eyepiece at left and a larger front objective at right.
violations: The front objective is distinctly wider than the rear eyepiece, but the visible diameter difference appears closer to about twice rather than the requested roughly three times.
The three-quarter view appears to include an additional brass telescoping stage or seam compared with the upper side view, so the two depictions do not read as perfectly identical geometry.
The upper view has slight perspective and exposes the front lens face rather than reading as a completely strict orthographic side view.

prompt:
[VISUAL_CONTRACT:spyglass_identity_v2] Create one 9:16 portrait object reference sheet for the captain's single compact maritime telescope. Keep its warm-brown main barrel, worn golden-brass telescoping sections, restrained seams and simple vintage design. In a clear SIDE VIEW, show a physically small, narrow REAR EYEPIECE and a visibly wider FRONT OBJECTIVE housing, roughly three times the eyepiece diameter. The narrow end is for the observer's eye; the broad end faces the distant subject. Both ends must be visible simultaneously. Add a three-quarter view of the exact same geometry; do not reverse the ends between views. Physical size, not perspective enlargement, defines each end.

The eyecup is the smallest optical opening, never a huge flared mouth. One continuous straight optical axis, no bent barrel, two broad lenses, unexplained extra tubes or equal-sized ends. No character, eye, hand, scene, topic imagery, labels, arrows, letters, frame border or decorative symbols. Neutral material background, confident hand-drawn outlines. A later entry frame supplies the actual captain and his eye relationship; this sheet must make that relationship unambiguous without printed instructions.

notes: extended_thinking_mode=Open mode picker, currently Flash Extended
